description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Priceline is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build and improve travel applications, including user-centered generative AI experiences. The role develops transactional services and AI-driven applications, collaborates across product and UX teams, and contributes to testing, performance optimization, and technical practices.
Associate Software Engineer building Generative AI applications and low-latency Java transactional services, integrating models into user interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Participate in mission critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business
• Be part of a cross-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives
• Showcase your development skills of Core Java or similar programming languages
• Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing
• Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications
• Utilize your knowledge to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications
• Effectively collaborate and engage in team efforts, speak up for what you think are the best solutions and be able to converse respectfully and compromise when necessary
• Design, develop, and optimize sophisticated Generative AI-driven applications that enhance user experiences and streamline interactions across platforms
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers of various disciplines, UX designers, and product managers to define user needs and translate them into effective AI solutions
• Join in and propose some of the architecture and implementation of applied generative AI models, ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into user interfaces and enhance the overall functionality of the platform
• Conduct testing and performance optimization to ensure high-quality and responsive user experiences, including troubleshooting and debugging as necessary
• Work with developers and contribute to the development of best practices within the team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation
• Stay ahead of industry trends in AI and UX, bringing new ideas and techniques to the team to ensure we remain competitive and at the cutting edge of technology

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related field
• 1+ year of experience in software engineering and development
• Strong coding experience  in JavaScript/TypeScript and corresponding tooling, NodeJS, HTML, CSS and React or equivalent frameworks are a must
• Strong understanding of UX principles and user-centered design
• You have hands-on experience with applied generative AI development using tools like the Langchain suite, Vercel AI, Mastra AI, Spring-AI or model provider APIs
• You excel in cross-functional environments, effectively communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• You have strong analytical skills, able to troubleshoot and refine algorithms and code for optimal performance
• Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

Preferred:
• Knowledge or experience with GraphQL is a strong bonus
• Experience developing in Docker and Cloud environments, especially GCP and AWS is nice to have
